## Documentation in progress

This page is incomplete but should provide enough examples to get you started. The live links below are to the example installation at [https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html), but you can replicate them just by opening a local copy of `iif-cite.html` in a web browser. The examples use:

- this IIIF manifest: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json) 
- this URN map: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-vol1-urns.cex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-vol1-urns.cex)
:::


## Addressing raw IIIF manifest data

- Start from the address of a **ready-to-use installation** of `iiif-cite.html` (e.g. `https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html))
- To add a **IIIF manifest**, append `#manifest=` (e.g., `#manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json))
- To add a **canvas id** for a selected image, append `&canvas=` (e.g. `&canvas=canvases/vol1_%2B_1r`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json&canvas=canvases/vol1_%2B_1r))
- To add a **region of interest**, append `&roi=` (e.g. `&roi=0.3009,0.0101,0.2744,0.0586`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json&canvas=canvases/vol1_%2B_1r&roi=0.3009,0.0101,0.2744,0.0586)). Multiple RoI values may provided, separated by semicolons. (e.g. `&roi=0.1857,0.1178,0.5239,0.0940;0.1733,0.5565,0.5414,0.1967`, [live link](neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json&canvas=canvases/vol1_%2B_1r&roi=0.1857,0.1178,0.5239,0.0940;0.1733,0.5565,0.5414,0.1967))



## Addressing cataloged files

- Start from the address of a **ready-to-use installation** of `iiif-cite.html` (e.g. `https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html))
- To add a **delimited-text catalog**, append `&catalog=` (e.g., `#catalog=https://shot.holycross.edu/images/mss/lipsius7/lips7.cex`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#catalog=https://shot.holycross.edu/images/mss/lipsius7/lips7.cex))
- To use **precomputed thumbnail images** for light table view, append `&thumbs=1` ([live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#catalog=https://shot.holycross.edu/images/mss/lipsius7/lips7.cex&thumbs=1))




## Addressing citable image data from IIIF sources

- Start from the address of a **ready-to-use installation** of `iiif-cite.html`  (e.g. `https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html))
- Add a manifest with `#manifest=` *and* a URN map with `urns=` (e.g., `manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json&urns=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-vol1-urns.cex`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json&urns=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-vol1-urns.cex))
- Append references to images with one or more additions of `&urn=` (e.g.`urn=urn:cite2:citebne:complutensian1.v1:v1p5@0.1857,0.1178,0.5239,0.0940`, [live link](
https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json&urns=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-vol1-urns.cex&urn=urn:cite2:citebne:complutensian1.v1:v1p5@0.1857,0.1178,0.5239,0.0940)) 



## Addressing citable image data from cataloged images

- Start from the address of a **ready-to-use installation** of `iiif-cite.html`  (e.g. `https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html))
- Add a **delimited-text catalog** with `&catalog=` (e.g., `#catalog=https://shot.holycross.edu/images/mss/lipsius7/lips7.cex`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#catalog=https://shot.holycross.edu/images/mss/lipsius7/lips7.cex))
- Append references to images with one or more additions of `&urn=` (e.g.`&urn=urn:cite2:citeleiden:lipsius7.v1:IMG_1203@0.4187,0.3937,0.1598,0.0182`, [live link](https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html#catalog=https://shot.holycross.edu/images/mss/lipsius7/lips7.cex&urn=urn:cite2:citeleiden:lipsius7.v1:IMG_1203@0.4187,0.3937,0.1598,0.0182))
